_comment: The landing-page index. Read at BUILD TIME by index.Rmd, which knits it into a complete static <ul>. The browser never fetches this file — assets/plotter.js only enhances the markup that is already there, so the index is present with JavaScript disabled. Edit here, then re-render index.Rmd.

_fields.label: Typed in monospace. Keep it under ~24 characters or it will wrap on a phone.
_fields.href: null means DELIBERATELY NOT LINKED — see note. Never invent a URL to fill this in.
_fields.note: Optional. Rendered after the blurb, in the dim voice, when href is null.
_fields.glyph: Key into the stroke dictionary in assets/plotter.js. Adding an entry here without adding the glyph there is harmless: the row simply draws nothing.
